description: A modal dialog that overlays the page. Focus is trapped inside the dialog while open. Built on Radix UI Dialog which provides full ARIA compliance including aria-modal, aria-labelledby, and aria-describedby.

keyboard.action: Cycles focus through focusable elements inside the dialog
Cycles focus backwards through the dialog

focus.notes: Focus is automatically moved to the first focusable element when the dialog opens. On close, focus returns to the trigger element. Focus is trapped — Tab/Shift+Tab cycle within the dialog boundary.

announcements: Dialog title is announced via aria-labelledby
Dialog description is announced via aria-describedby
The dialog is announced as a modal dialog (aria-modal="true")
screenReader.notes: The overlay prevents interaction with elements behind the dialog. Screen readers will not navigate outside the dialog while it is open.

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA — dialog uses card-foreground on card background

consumerResponsibilities: Always include a DialogTitle for screen reader context
Include DialogDescription for additional context when needed
Ensure the trigger element clearly indicates it opens a dialog
For destructive actions, consider using aria-describedby to link to a warning
